trigger.description: The default semantic path is neural-local via Frankensearch Model2Vec (potion-multilingual-128M). This degradation occurs when that bundled model cannot be loaded or downloaded, when EE_EMBED_MODEL_PATH explicitly points at a missing fault-injection path, or in the rare deterministic-hash fallback posture where the active embedder reports semantic=false while lexical fallback remains available.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Cargo workspace uses Rust nightly.' --workspace . --level semantic --kind fact --json
